reviews_data.review_text: I stopped by 3rd space and had the greatest time meeting James and Sage!! They were so nice and talked to me all about my day and were so personable.
The staff were so sweet and attentive to all of our needs! The coffees were so delicious and the fresh-baked scones were TO DIE FOR! I will definitely come back!!

We stopped by this morning for coffee. My husband drinks drip coffee and unfortunately they didn't have that, but I got a latte. I actually got a featured lemon meringue latte, iced. It was pretty good. I appreciate the homemade touches, the lemon curd and the cold foam. The staff were very friendly. I'd definitely come back.
I love 3rd space! You can really tell that everything is made with thoughtfulness and love! Such a fun community too!
